_about: One everyday detail of how a drafted character looks, rolled by dramatis/looks.py so the Appearance never falls back on the model's own favourite (three drafts in a row came back with a chickenpox scar above the left eyebrow). Habits, wear and what they carry, not marks on their body: a mark people notice is the Something people notice field. A roll picks a group, then a detail in it, so drafts spread across kinds of detail. In each group 'any' fits every era, 'modern' only the present day and the future, 'period' only the past and fantasy settings.

any: callused fingertips
short, practical nails
nails bitten to the quick
a ring they turn when they are thinking
dry, cracked knuckles in winter
a thumbnail they pick at when bored
hands that are never quite still
a pale band where a ring used to be
fingers that drum on whatever is nearest
a plaster on one finger more often than not
a grip on cups with both hands
chalk or flour worked into the creases of their palms
modern: chipped nail polish they never get round to removing
a smartwatch they check without meaning to
a pen-click habit
a hair tie always on one wrist
a fading festival wristband
period: ink-dark fingertips from letters
a signet ring worn smooth
fingerless gloves in all weather
a needle and thread pinned inside a cuff

any: sleeves always pushed up to the elbow
a coat a size too big
a collar that never sits flat
a button sewn back on in the wrong colour
shoes resoled more than once
boots with the laces wrapped twice
a scarf in every season
clothes chosen for their pockets
one good jacket worn with everything
a hem let down and the old crease still showing
socks that never match
everything in shades of one colour
a hat pulled low whatever the weather
a faded patch where a bag strap rubs
dust or flour on their cuffs more often than not
a shirt tucked in on one side only
modern: trainers worn down at the heels
a hoodie with the drawstrings chewed
a jacket with a pin from a band nobody else knows
a work fleece with the logo picked off
jeans with a phone-shaped fade in the back pocket
a lanyard they forget to take off
a puffer jacket with tape over a tear
a T-shirt from a 5K they never ran
period: a waistcoat with one button missing
a cloak mended at the shoulder
boots blacked every morning
an apron they forget to take off
a shawl pinned with a tin brooch
sleeves rolled and tied with string

any: keys clipped to a belt loop
a pencil tucked behind one ear
a handkerchief always in one pocket
a pocket that always holds something to eat
a battered notebook with a rubber band round it
a bag that weighs more than it should
reading glasses on a cord
a knife or tool on their belt
a folded list in a back pocket
a flask that goes everywhere with them
modern: phone in a cracked case with a card wedged behind it
earbuds that live around their neck
a tote bag from a shop that closed years ago
a reusable cup with a chipped lid
a backpack with one strap broken
a car key with too many loyalty tags on it
a lip balm in every pocket
a charging cable in every bag
period: a pocket watch on a chain
a pipe they rarely light
a coin purse on a cord round the neck
a sprig of something tucked in a buttonhole
a whetstone in a coat pocket

any: hair that escapes whatever holds it by noon
a parting that wanders
eyebrows that need a trim
a fringe they keep pushing out of their eyes
hair still damp from the morning more days than not
a cowlick that will not lie flat
a faint smell of woodsmoke or soap about them
chapped lips in winter
modern: sunglasses pushed up on their head indoors
roots growing out under an old dye
a fresh haircut that is not quite even
a claw clip that does most of the work
a cap with a curved brim and a sweat line
period: hair braided tight for work
a beard or braid kept with a bit of twine
a hat that leaves a line across the forehead

any: a habit of standing with their weight on one hip
a slight squint when they read
a posture that straightens when someone looks at them
a watch worn face-in on the wrist
shoulders that ride up when they are listening
a walk that is always slightly too fast
a habit of leaning on doorframes
arms folded whenever they are thinking
a head tilt when they disagree
a way of sitting on the edge of chairs
a quick glance at exits when they come into a room
a laugh they cover with one hand
a slouch that comes back as soon as they stop thinking about it
a habit of humming under their breath
modern: a thumb hovering over a phone screen
a habit of checking their reflection in shop windows
posture bent from years at a desk
period: a bow of the head to anyone who looks important
the careful stride of someone who has carried loads
